name: cut-paste-sky-collage
keep: KEEP — the making of the image, copy exactly:
· MEDIUM: analogue cut-and-paste photo collage on a scanned print, snapshot photography with a slightly soft, faded reproduction quality.
· GROUND: a clear blue daytime sky dotted with soft white cumulus clouds behind the whole figure.
· SIGNATURE TREATMENT: a surreal face-swap — a separate freckled face photo trimmed and pasted flat onto the head at a mismatched scale and angle, seams visible.
· LIGHT: bright natural daylight, warm and even, gentle contrast.
· PALETTE: sky-blue and cloud-white ground, vivid tangerine-orange top, faded denim-blue jeans, warm freckled skin.
· TEXTURE: fine scanned-print grain and slight colour fading, like a magazine page or photocopy.
· MOOD: playful, uncanny, dreamy surreal-collage lightness.
· No readable text, no letters, no numerals, no logo, no watermark anywhere.
